verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents AI-driven browser agents that start tasks from a single API call and run live in cloud sessions. Built-in agents include Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok and BrowserUse. HyperAgent's `page.ai()` accepts multi-step natural-language goals, such as searching for flights and selecting the cheapest option, in place of selectors. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of form-filling and multi-page flow handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end task completion.
